camel_example: aliyun ice SubmitTextGenerateJob --region cn-hangzhou --Type MarketingCopy --Description Test_Description --UserData '{"NotifyAddress":"http://xx.xx.xxx"}' --Title Test_Title --GenerateConfig '{"keywords":"New_store_cake,Animal_cream","textLength":100,"targetCount":3}' --version 2020-11-09 --method POST --force
description_en: Generates marketing copy based on the submitted keywords, word count, and number of copies. Due to the characteristics of the Chinese language, the word count of the generated copy may differ from the requested word count. After the task is successfully submitted, call the GetSmartHandleJob operation by using the job ID to query the task status and results
description_zh: 根据提交的关键词、字数、文案数，扩写出营销文案。由于中文的特殊性，输出文案字数可能跟需求字数有出入。提交任务成功后，根据JobId调用GetSmartHandleJob接口获取任务状态和结果

parameters.help_en: The task description. The value can be up to 1,024 bytes in length and must be encoded in UTF-8
parameters.help_zh: 任务描述，长度不超过1024字节（UTF8编码）
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The task type. Valid values:
MarketingCopy: marketing copy.
Title: short video title.
StoryboardScript: storyboard script generated from copy
parameters.help_zh:
任务类型。枚举值：
MarketingCopy：营销文案。
Title：短视频标题。
StoryboardScript：文案生成分镜脚本
parameters.name: type

parameters.example: {"keywords":"New store cake,Animal cream","textLength":100,"targetCount":3} or {"originText": "A new cake shop has opened on the street,Selling cream cakes,Fruit cake,Bread,Muffins, etc..A coffee shop has opened across from the cake shop,An endless stream of customers."}
parameters.help_en:
The generation configuration. If Type is set to Title or MarketingCopy, you must specify the following fields:
keywords: the keywords used to generate the title or marketing copy. Required.
textLength: the word count of the generated copy. Valid values: 5 to 1000. The actual word count of the generated copy may be slightly less than or equal to this value, but will not exceed it. Required.
targetCount: the number of copies to generate. Valid values: 1 to 1000. Required.

If Type is set to StoryboardScript, you must specify the following field:
originText: the original copy used to generate the storyboard script. Required
parameters.help_zh:
生成配置。Type = Title 或MarketingCopy时，需填写以下字段：
keywords：生成标题或营销文案的关键词。必填。
textLength：生成文案的字数，取值范围 5~1000。实际生成的文案字数可能略少于或等于此值，但不会超过。必填。
targetCount：生成的文案数量，取值范围 1~1000。必填。

Type = StoryboardScript 时，需填写以下字段：
originText：用于生成分镜脚本的原始文案，必填
